cards.title: How to Start Walking When You're Plus Size: A Gentle 4-Week Plan
cards.excerpt: A calm four-week walking plan with three planned walks each week, an optional short walk, and simple reflections. Start with a pace that feels manageable, and repeat a week whenever you need more time. Explore the Gentle Walking guide.

cards.title: Simple Meal Prep for Busy Weeks: 10 Easy Ideas, No Strict Diet Needed
cards.excerpt: Ten flexible meal-prep ideas for busy weeks, with simple ways to plan ahead and make a shopping list. Use what suits your schedule, preferences, and needs—no strict diet rules. Explore Simple Meal Planner.

cards.imageAlt: Woman following a gentle chair-based movement at home
cards.title: Chair Workouts for Beginners: 8 Gentle Moves You Can Do at Home
cards.excerpt: Explore eight gentle movements you can do at home, with a chair option for each. The four-week guide offers a simple structure and room to choose the level that feels appropriate for you—no equipment needed. Meet Move at Home.

cards.imageAlt: Person using a journal to reflect and choose a next step
cards.title: How to Restart Your Routine After a Setback, Without Guilt
cards.excerpt: A 14-day guide for returning to routines after a pause. Reflect on what got in the way, prepare a small Plan B, and choose one manageable next step—without punishment or trying to make up for missed days. Explore Back on Track.

cards.imageAlt: Walking shoes and a notebook set out for a weekly routine
cards.title: Staying Consistent When Motivation Disappears: 7 Habits That Actually Work
cards.excerpt: Seven practical ways to make a routine easier to return to when motivation feels low: choose a smaller starting step, link an action to an existing cue, and keep a flexible Plan B. Explore the Curvafit three-guide bundle for walking, meal planning, and at-home movement.

cards.imageAlt: Comfortable activewear layers for everyday movement
cards.title: Anti-Chafing Tips for Plus-Size Women: What to Wear and What to Avoid
cards.excerpt: A practical look at comfortable layers: choose a smooth feel and a fit that stays in place without digging in, and look for fabrics that move moisture away from the skin. Avoid rough or irritating seams. When Curvafit leggings and anti-chafing shorts become available, check their product pages for details.

cards.imageAlt: Plus-size woman preparing for a calm first gym visit
cards.title: Your First Day at the Gym: A Calm, Confidence-Building Guide
cards.excerpt: A calm walkthrough for planning your first visit: decide what feels comfortable, start with a simple activity, take breaks, and ask gym staff questions. Prefer to begin at home? Explore gentle, equipment-free routines in Move at Home.

cards.title: The Plate Method Explained: Balanced Meals Without Counting Calories
cards.excerpt: A flexible visual starting point for planning meals with vegetables, protein, and grains or starches, adapted to your preferences and needs. It is an idea, not a strict rule, and does not require calorie counting. Explore Simple Meal Planner for meal grids and shopping-list prompts.
